method.name: exact-token-shapley
method.features: Each non-special input token position is one player.
method.masking: Replace absent token IDs with [MASK]; preserve sequence length, positions, special tokens, and an all-one attention mask. Run the entire model for every coalition.
method.baseline: Model margin with all non-special positions replaced by [MASK]. This baseline need not be neutral and can depend on sequence length.
method.coalition_indexing: Array index is a bitmask. Bit i is 1 when feature_positions[i] retains its original token, and 0 when replaced by [MASK].
method.formula: phi_i = sum_{S subset N\{i}} (1 / (n * binom(n-1, |S|))) * (v(S union {i}) - v(S))
method.display_grouping: Word labels sum the exact subword token Shapley values. They are not separately computed whole-word coalition Shapley values.
method.scope: Attributions describe this classifier's whole-input sentiment under this masking rule, not an intrinsic word sentiment or a causal explanation of its internal attention.
method.approximation: All coalitions enumerated; only model floating-point arithmetic is approximate. No Partition/Owen hierarchy or sampling.
